prompt: Write a welcome message for a new museum volunteer. Output exactly three bullet lines. The first line must start '- Arrival:' and include 'front desk'. The second must start '- Training:' and include 'badge'. The third must start '- Contact:' and include 'coordinator'. No other text.

Give a neutral two-sentence summary of this notice: The North Branch library will close at 6 pm on Thursday for electrical work. Book returns remain available through the outside slot. Reopening is scheduled for Friday at 9 am. Do not use an exclamation mark.
Classify this request using exactly one of these labels and nothing else: ROUTINE or URGENT. Request: 'The office printer is low on paper, but printing can continue for now.'
Rewrite this as one polite sentence of at most 18 words: 'Send me the updated schedule today.' The sentence must contain 'please' and must not contain 'ASAP'.
List the three actions in the note as numbered lines, in the original order, with no introductory sentence: save the draft, ask Mina to review it, then send the approved version to the client.
Explain how to request a room booking in exactly two short sentences. Include the words 'calendar' and 'confirmation'. Do not use a numbered list.

Return exactly four lines in this order: a heading beginning 'Title:', a line beginning 'Owner:', a line beginning 'Due:', and a line beginning 'Status:'. Use these values: migration checklist; Hana; 14 June; in review. Do not add any other lines.
Answer in exactly five words with a calm tone: what should a visitor do if the front gate is locked? Mention the word 'reception'.

Read the memo: 'Shipment K-184 left Osaka on 12 May with 36 cartons. Carrier: Blue Finch. Delivery window: 15 May, 13:00-16:00.' Return only valid JSON with keys shipment, origin, date_left, cartons, carrier, delivery_date.

From this note, extract the event title, venue, start time and contact email: 'Community Repair Cafe — Cedar Hall — Saturday, 10:30 am — repairs@cedar.example'. Output one JSON object only, with keys title, venue, start_time, email.

Extract the three product facts from the description and output only JSON with keys material, color, care. Description: 'The travel mug is made from stainless steel, comes in forest green, and should be hand-washed.'
Convert the following service record into JSON only, keys ticket, customer, issue, priority: 'Ticket 5082; customer Leila Park; issue: duplicate invoice; priority: normal.'

From the itinerary extract train number, departure station, departure time and arrival station. Return only JSON with keys train, from, departure, to. Itinerary: 'Train IC 728 departs Utrecht Centraal at 08:42 and arrives at Arnhem at 09:31.'

Read the policy excerpt: 'Staff may work remotely on Monday and Wednesday. Requests for other days need approval from a team lead. The shared office day is Thursday.' Return only JSON with keys remote_days, other_days_rule, shared_day.

Extract the meeting details and return only JSON with keys date, time, platform, agenda. Note: 'On 22 August at 15:00 UTC, the accessibility review will meet on Jitsi. Agenda: screen-reader navigation and captions.'
Return only JSON with keys name, role, languages, availability from this profile: 'Noor Haddad is a library assistant. Noor speaks Arabic and French and is available Tuesday afternoons.'

Write a two-sentence public update using only these facts: the riverside path is closed between Oak Bridge and the boathouse; repairs begin 3 September; the lower garden remains open. Keep a neutral tone.
Turn these facts into exactly two concise bullet points: the clinic moved to Room 12; appointments keep their original times; check in at the east entrance. Do not invent a phone number.
Write a short handover note in exactly three labeled lines: 'Completed:', 'Pending:', 'Next:'. Facts: the archive was indexed; 14 photographs still need captions; Jo will review captions on Tuesday.
Draft a one-sentence apology to a customer using these facts: the replacement parcel was delayed by a sorting error; it is now due Wednesday. Do not promise compensation.
Write a three-item checklist for preparing a meeting room using only these items: test the projector, place name cards, refill water. Use checkbox bullets beginning '- [ ]'.

Write exactly two sentences for a gallery label. Facts: the sculpture is called 'Tidal Mark'; artist Emi Sato made it in 2021 from reclaimed cedar; it reflects on coastal change. Avoid first-person pronouns.
Write a brief, factual announcement in exactly two lines: the west elevator will be unavailable on 5 October; the east elevator and stairs remain open. Do not imply the whole building is closed.
Write a polite one-sentence reminder containing both 'Wednesday' and 'consent form'. The form should be returned to the reception desk. Do not add a deadline other than Wednesday.
